Project Name: For Project Name, ignore spaces, lower and cupper case, in both ref and comparable values for matching. Where the project name consists of a roman value in ref or comparable, convert it into number before matching. Do not ignore any other words in ref or comparable for comparsion. If then the value matches, the score is 1, else 0.
Builder Name: Ignore spacing and capitalization for matching. Ignore words like Builders, Developers, realtors, LLP, Pvt, Ltd, Limited. If ref and comparable match, score is 1, else 0.
Project Address: Reference value will have locality and a city name separated by a comma. For matching project address, see if the same locality and city name exist in the compared values ignoring stop characters (spaces, comma, hyphen, full-stop). If they exist, then match is 1, else 0.
Avg Price psft: For Avg Price psft, the comparable prices can be an absolute amount or a range. When the comparable is in the form of a range, if the Reference value falls within range of comparable value, then the score is 1, else 0. When the comparable is an absolute amount, if the comparable value is within +/- 500 of reference value, then the match score is 1 else 0.
Avg Price psft Type: For Avg Price psft Price Type, the comparable prices can be an absolute amount or a range. The values can be a combination of words and numbers. Ignore words, detect if the price also known as 'Price Type' in reference and comparable are in range or absolute form. If the comparables are the same 'Price type' as the reference value then score is 1, else 0. Also, give consensus value as Point where the price is an absolute amount and as Range where the price is in a range.
Property Type: For Property Type, ignore configs and compare the property type only, i.e., Apartment (also called as flat), villas (also called as Row house), studio apartment (also called as 1 RK, studio, bed studio, service/ serviced apartment), independent floor (also called as ind floor, builder floor), land (also called as plot, residential plot), etc. If the property type in the reference value matches with the value of the comparable, the score is 1, otherwise score will be 0.
Completion date: For Completion date, reference and comparable values are different format of month, date and year of completion. Convert all values in MMM-YYYY format to form Converted Date. If the ref value and comparables have the same converted date, then match is 1 else 0.
Project Area: For Project area, area will be a measure and a unit. Unit of area can be in different formats like- acres/acre, hectare, sq ft, sq yards. Ignore any special characters and detail like (75% open space) or 60% open area. If the units are in different formats, convert the values into acres. Then Match the unit in the reference value to units in the comparable values. Round reference and comparable to 1 decimal place before comparing. If then the reference and comparable match upto one decimal place, the matching score would be 1, else 0.
RERA: For RERA, each value will be a sequence of numbers and alphabets and special characters (example: GGM/831/563/2024/58). Ignore Rera Not Applicable, Not Applicable and OC Applied and while comparing. Compare the numbers and alphabets in reference value to that of comparable. If they are the same, then match is 1 else 0.
Project Size - Tower Count: For Project Size - Tower Count, each value will be a number. Compare the numbers in reference value to numbers in compared values. Ignore words like tower, building, buildings, twr, bldg. If the number in reference is the same as comparable, then matching score is 1 else 0.
Project Size - Unit Count: For Project Size - Unit Count, each value is a number. Ignore words like unit, units. If reference number is the same as comparable, the matching score would be 1, else 0.
Configs: For Project configs, each value will be a set of numbers and its unit (example: 1 bhk / 1 RK / 2 bhk). Unit will be BHK or bhk. If any value is in decimal, round it down to the nearest whole number (ex- 3.5 BHK should be rounded down to 3 BHK). Then Compare the number and its unit in reference value to numbers and their unit in comparable. If the set of numbers in the reference and comparable match, irrespective of sequence, then the matching score will be 1, else 0.
Amenities - Count: For Amenities - Count, each value is a number. Compare the numbers in reference to numbers in comparable. If the number in reference is greater than or equal to comparable, then the matching score should be 1, else 0.
Photos: For Photos, value is a number (example: 8). Compare the numbers in reference value to numbers in comparable. If the number in reference is greater than or equal to comparable, the matching score is 1, else 0.
Videos: For Videos, value is a number (example: 8). Compare the numbers in reference value to numbers in comparable. If the number in reference is greater than or equal to comparable, the matching score is 1, else 0.
Review Count: For Review Count, value is a number (example: 8). Ignore any words or special characters like ratings, reviews, review, rating, (). Compare the numbers in reference value to numbers in comparable. If the number in reference is greater than or equal to comparable, the matching score is 1, else 0.
Builder-Established Date: For Builder-Established Date, if the value is a year (e.g., 1995 or contracted like '95), convert it to the full year (e.g., 1995). If the value includes a duration (e.g., 30 yrs, 23+ years, 24 Years Experience), extract the numeric part and subtract it from 2025 to get the establishment year. Normalize all values to a standard 4-digit year. Compare the resulting years across each record. If the establishmant year as per reference matches with the comparable, the matching score will be 1, else 0.
Builder-Project Count: For Builder-Project Count, value will be a number (example: 8). Ignore any words or special characters like project, projects, etc. Compare the numbers in reference value to numbers in comparable. If the number in reference value is greater than comparable or equal to, then the matching score is 1, else 0.
Possession Status: For Possession status, the value will be possession status of the project- Ready to Move (Also known as R2M, RTM, Ready), Under Construction (Also known as UC, ongoing), New Launch (Also known as NL, new), Partial Ready to move (also known as Partially Ready to move, it is not the same as Ready to move). Ignore special characters if any. Compare the value in reference with comparable. If the possession status in reference matches with possession status in comparable, then match is 1 else 0.
